summary: Iter54 · Phase 37 Phase 3 (Stages 5-Assessment, 6-Placement, and Attendance CSV export). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass in 10.11s covering (a) PATCH /api/batches/{bid}/assessment persists sdms_batch_id/agency/assessor/date/status and center-manager scope; (b) POST candidates/{cid}/assessment with status=passed auto-sets certified=true, marks/remarks saved, batch counters resync (passed_candidates=1, total_certified=1, pass_count=1); status=failed keeps certified=false and increments fail_count; (c) POST candidates/assessment/bulk applies 4 rows and resyncs counters (passed_candidates, total_certified, fail_count, absent_count); empty rows[] returns 400; (d) GET assessment/summary returns present/absent/passed/failed/certified/certification_pct/pass_pct with correct values; (e) PATCH candidates/{cid}/placement blocks placement_status='placed' with 400 for non-certified candidates ('Only certified candidates can be marked as placed'); succeeds after certifying, updates placed_candidates + num_placement; (f) POST candidates/placement/bulk silently skips non-certified rows (returns updated=2 out of 3 submitted); (g) GET placement/summary returns total_enrolled=4, certified=4, placed=3, placement_pct=75.0, pending_placement=1, retention.month_1=2/month_2=1, ctc.avg=300000/min=200000/max=400000; (h) GET /api/batches/{bid}/attendance/export.csv returns valid CSV with header 'Candidate ID, Name, Mobile, <dates>, Present, Absent, Holiday, Present %', text/csv content-type and Content-Disposition attachment; date-range query params respected; (i) RBAC: unauthenticated PATCH assessment and CSV export return 401/403. Regression: /api/batches, /api/batch-targets, /api/mis/live/overview all 200. Frontend: /batch-management renders; tabs 5·Assessment and 6·Placement are ENABLED (not disabled as they were in iter53); both stages load with 82 batches in the dropdown; Assessment stage shows SDMS/agency/date/assessor/contact/status form + 'Save Batch Info' button; Placement stage loads with certified-candidate filter working; Attendance stage 'Export CSV' button visible after batch select and downloads a valid CSV.

issues: React warning persists: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' AND 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled' — occurs on Assessment stage meta form (Input value={meta.sdms_batch_id} where meta is loaded async, initial value undefined). Same warning was flagged in iter52+iter53 for enrollment/attendance selects. Fix: initialise meta state with all keys as '' or use value={x||''} on the Input+Select controls in AssessmentStage.jsx lines 113-120.

action_items: (Low) Fix 'uncontrolled→controlled' warnings in AssessmentStage.jsx — initialise meta state with empty strings for sdms_batch_id/assessment_agency/assessor_name/assessor_contact/assessment_date/assessment_status BEFORE the async load fills them, or fall back to value={meta.field ?? ''}. Same pattern in PlacementStage form.

(Low) PlacementStage.jsx bulk placement client-side does NOT block sending non-certified rows to server — relies on server to silently drop them. Consider showing a toast like 'Skipped N non-certified candidates' after bulk save so users are informed why some rows didn't update.

(Low) Attendance CSV filename generated server-side uses batch name which may contain spaces/slashes — filename= header would benefit from RFC-5987 encoding or slug-safe sanitisation for special chars. Currently works for TEST_ batches but might break on unicode batch names.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:11109 — certified field is auto-computed as (body.status == 'passed') when caller does not send explicit certified. This means calling POST assessment with status='passed' after a prior manual certified=false will silently override to certified=true. If UX ever wants 'passed but not certified' (e.g. SDMS pending), this default is wrong. Consider requiring explicit certified for status=passed.

server.py:11144 — bulk_assess_candidates uses UpdateOne but does NOT filter batch_id in the outer permission check per row — a malicious center-manager could submit rows with candidate_ids from another batch (though the UpdateOne filter includes batch_id=bid so it silently drops). Consider returning matched vs modified so UI can flag mismatches.

server.py:11256 — bulk_place_candidates does synchronous find_one per row inside a for-loop (N+1 query pattern). For 100+ rows this will be slow. Suggest one find with $in on candidate_ids to build a certified-set, then filter rows.

server.py:11291 — placement_pct divides by certified (not enrolled). If certified=0 but placed>0 (impossible via API but possible via legacy data), returns 0% — misleading. Also test_iter54 test_placement_summary asserts placement_pct == 75.0 == 3/4 (certified) which matches business rule. Confirmed intentional but worth documenting in API doc.

server.py:11146 — bulk_write with ordered=False is correct but return payload lacks failed IDs. UI can't tell which rows silently failed (e.g., candidate not found, wrong batch). Add {'skipped': [...], 'updated': n}.

AttendanceStage.jsx:110 — filename constructed from activeBatch?.name without sanitisation; browser will handle spaces via a[download] but if batch name has slashes it will create sub-paths. Add name.replace(/[^a-z0-9-_]/gi, '_').

PlacementStage.jsx:80 — form.ctc coerced with Number(form.ctc) || 0 — an input of '0' becomes 0 fine, but '' becomes 0 as well, so a user clearing the field silently saves 0. Consider allowing null and preserving prior value if empty.
seed_data_creation: pytest run creates TEST_BM54_* target + batches + candidates and cleans them up via fixture teardown. No UI test batches created (only navigated existing seeded data). Prior TEST_iter15_batch_770669_tds10 with 1 placed candidate at Reliance ₹2,20,000 is still present and untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 37 is now COMPLETE (all 7 stages functional). Iter54 covered Stages 5+6 + Attendance CSV. Endpoints in scope: PATCH /api/batches/{bid}/assessment, POST /api/batches/{bid}/candidates/{cid}/assessment, POST /api/batches/{bid}/candidates/assessment/bulk, GET /api/batches/{bid}/assessment/summary, PATCH /api/batches/{bid}/candidates/{cid}/placement (400 for non-certified 'placed'), POST /api/batches/{bid}/candidates/placement/bulk (silently skips non-certified), GET /api/batches/{bid}/placement/summary, GET /api/batches/{bid}/attendance/export.csv (?from_date&to_date). Roles ASSESS_ROLES/PLACE_ROLES=(admin,manager,senior_manager,hr,center_manager); CSV export also allows accountant. Frontend testids: bm-assess-{stage,batch,sdms,agency,date,assessor,contact,status,save-meta,bulk-<k>,row-<cid>,chip-<cid>-<k>,cert-<cid>}, bm-place-{stage,batch,row-<cid>,edit-<cid>,dialog,inp-status/employer/location/designation/joining/ctc/ret1/ret2/ret3/remarks,save}, bm-att-export. Batch counters auto-resync: passed_candidates, total_certified, pass_count, fail_count, absent_count, actual_present (assessment) and placed_candidates, num_placement (placement).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. Only minor UX-warning issue with uncontrolled-to-controlled Select/Input (carry-over from iter52/53, still not fixed). Low priority.
